description:
## Why

Subset of PKIX-l63j epic. PKITS contains zero non-ASCII / non-PrintableString DN fixtures; new test coverage for BMPString and Unicode-normalized DN comparison must come from a synthetic corpus.

## What

Build synthetic fixtures:
- chains where intermediate Subject DN uses BMPString or UTF8String for non-ASCII CN
- mixed-encoding chains: PrintableString in one cert, BMPString in another with same logical Unicode
- canonical-equivalence pairs: precomposed vs decomposed accented Latin
- T61String corpus (if PKIX-l63j.3 chooses to support it)

Generation: OpenSSL with custom asn1conf, or pyca/cryptography `x509.NameAttribute(... _ASN1Type.BMPString)`. Document the generation script for reproducibility. Commit DER fixtures.

## Acceptance

- See parent PKIX-l63j acceptance.
title: pkix-path: foreign-language DN test corpus (BMPString/UTF8String mixed encodings)
